item.title: Loans in focus: Standard Chartered and Crédit Agricole finance Berlin data centre campus, Affinius writes its first European loan, Cerberus refinances UK PBSA with £63m
item.description: Standard Chartered and Crédit Agricole provide a €210 million financing to facilitate the development of a data centre campus in Berlin; Affinius Capital issues an £80 million (€92 million) loan to refinance two purpose-built student accommodation assets in the UK in its European lending debut; Cerberus Capital Management refinances UK PBSA assets owned by Zenzic Capital and developer Torsion Group; the latest additions to the Real Estate Capital Europe lending database; and more in our round-up

item.title: Why European real estate credit looks safer than equity in the new cycle
item.description: In this podcast, AllianceBernstein’s Clark Coffee says valuing assets is becoming more challenging, making it more important for equity investors to pick the winners. But credit lenders just need to avoid the losers. The post Why European real estate credit looks safer than equity in the new cycle appeared first on Real Estate Capital Europe.
